proof_body:
by
  intro f M a b hab hc hb hM
  have hsub : Set.uIoc a b ⊆ Set.Icc a b := by
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab]
    exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  refine intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun n _ => M n) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro n
    exact ((hc n).mono hsub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
  · intro n
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hb n x (hsub hx))
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x _ => hM)
  · exact intervalIntegrable_const
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx =>
      (Summable.of_norm_bounded hM (fun n => hb n x (hsub hx))).hasSum)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → (∀ n, ContinuousOn (f n) (Set.Icc a b)) → (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f n x| ≤ M n) → Summable M → HasSum (fun n => ∫ x in a..b, f n x) (∫ x in a..b, ∑' n, f n x)
